answer: Run a randomized re-verification lottery. Each agent locks 300 tokens as a bond. Every epoch the registry draws 5 percent of identities at random, and a drawn agent has 24 hours to pass a live check no script can replay. Miss it or fail, and the bond is slashed and the identity revoked. A farmer running 1,000 fakes locks $300,000 and faces about 50 surprise checks per epoch, each needing roughly 20 minutes of human-like work, 17 hours of labor each epoch just to stand still. Like a quill in a dune, a fake cannot hide from the wind, and the canyon of honest work it must cross only widens.
